learnerOutcome: Choose between static, aggregate and generated routes for a given need, and confirm each one in the route table with the right protocol and next hop.
observableOutcomes: The branch router has static routes for both remote subnets.
The branch router can ping an address inside each remote subnet.
The headquarters router has an aggregate-protocol route for the summary prefix.
The upstream router has the summary route.
The upstream router does not have the specific subnet routes (negated check).
The branch router has a default route learned as an aggregate/generated route pointing at headquarters.
rationale: This is the foundation of the Protocol Independent Routing chapter and its lab section. All three route types can be seen with route-exists, so it is fully observable. The set runs from simple to conditional.
scenario: A branch router reaches two small remote subnets through a headquarters router. The upstream router should see one summary instead of several specifics, and the branch needs a default route that exists only while the headquarters path is alive. You are asked to finish the routing so the tables show exactly that.

stageSketch.achieves: The branch router holds static routes for both remote subnets with the headquarters router as next hop, and can ping them.
stageSketch.title: Reach the remote subnets

stageSketch.achieves: The headquarters router holds an aggregate route covering both subnets, and it is the aggregate that is passed upstream, so the upstream router has the summary and not the specifics.
stageSketch.title: Summarise for the upstream router

stageSketch.achieves: The branch router holds a generated default route whose existence depends on a contributing route through headquarters, with the headquarters router as its next hop.
stageSketch.title: Make a conditional default

startStateSketch: Three routers in a line (branch, headquarters, upstream) with addressed links and loopbacks. Each router has only its connected routes. The remote subnets sit on loopback addresses of the headquarters router.
title: Summarise a branch's routes with static, aggregate and generated routes

nodes.role: Branch router that needs the remote subnets and a conditional default
Headquarters router that owns the remote subnets and builds the summary
Upstream router that should only see the summary
